prompts.title: Q: Why is GCM nonce reuse dangerous?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Reusing a nonce with the same key can leak relationships between plaintexts and can break integrity guarantees.

prompts.title: Q: Is SHA-256 okay for password storage?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** No. Use memory-hard or adaptive password KDFs (Argon2id/bcrypt/scrypt/PBKDF2 with tuned parameters).

prompts.title: Q: CBC + HMAC still acceptable?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** It can be safe if correctly implemented (encrypt-then-MAC), but AEAD reduces implementation risk.

prompts.title: Q: How do you roll keys safely?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Version keys, support dual-decrypt windows, re-encrypt gradually, and monitor failures.
